data.narrative:
Ares Industries, a Series A-stage Defense & Security company founded by Alex Tseng and Devan Plantamura, has raised $31M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers (2 public, 8 private) in the same sector and stage, including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing.

The peer-median method is the sole applicable triangulation approach. The analysis identified three same-sector, same-stage comparables with a median valuation of $400M and a range spanning $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence). The stage-progression method was excluded because its implied valuation of $23.6B exceeded 20x the company's total raised, suggesting the underlying base value was unreliable. No revenue or profitability multiples could be applied given the absence of disclosed financial metrics.

The triangulated valuation range is $340M to $460M, with a median point of $400M, supported by the peer-median methodology alone. Key uncertainties include the substantial dispersion within the peer set (32x spread from low to high), the limited sample size of three direct comparables, and the absence of financial performance data to contextualize relative positioning within the peer range. The valuation reflects early-stage positioning but remains sensitive to product maturity, customer traction, and defensibility relative to the identified peer group.
